audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 were marked Skill despite the why calling it 'your tank lane-control peak', and both late rows were given to K'Sante despite the why saying 'Warwick out-scales you'.
audit.why: Pre-item Warwick has no burst — Blood Hunt is move and attack speed only — so 4-5 is K'Sante's. Late, Eternal Hunger's healing triples under 25% and Jaws of the Beast is percent max health, so the tank loses the scaling race.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / K'Sante / K'Sante / K'Sante / Skill / Skill / Warwick, matching the packet and the 51.19% win rate over 586 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; Warwick's spikes were described only as 'his R' and 'his passive'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and suppresses for 1.5s; Jaws of the Beast is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s; Primal Howl is 15/14/13/12/11s. The 110-second R at rank 1 is the single biggest punish window in the lane.
audit.corrected: Spikes now carry the 1.5s suppression, R's 110s, and Jaws' 8s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text told the player four separate times to 'save W's unstoppable charge to break the suppress'. K'Sante's W is not unstoppable in the data, and nothing in his kit removes a suppression. Primal Howl (E) — 2.5s damage reduction plus a 1-second flee — was never mentioned at all, and the 2-stack Ntofo shockwave was called a knock-up.
audit.why: Riot's W text says only 'charges up, taking reduced damage'. Riot's R text for Warwick: 'suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds' — a suppression, which the kit files give no cleanse route for. Riot's Q text: 'K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.'
audit.corrected: The advice is now to bait Infinite Duress and punish its cooldown rather than to break it; Primal Howl's damage reduction and fear are named; the shockwave is a pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was in the item block but never tied to a trade, and the page told a tank to answer Warwick with armour.
audit.why: Both flagged missing interactions apply: Warwick sustains through Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress, and Jaws is percent max health, so stacking resistances reads the trade wrong.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds is now stated inside the mid-game trading rule, and the percent-health point replaces 'armour stacking' as the late-game explanation.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo lands — W into terrain for the stun, Q3 knock-up — and you burst him before his Q drain heals it back.
edits.after: Your Q-W lands — W into terrain for the stun, then the Ntofo pull — and you burst him before Jaws of the Beast heals it back.

edits.before: At 6 his R suppress can lock you for a full combo, but your W unstoppable can break it — the all-in goes either way, so it's even.
edits.after: At 6 Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5s through everything, but it is 110s at rank 1 — bait it and the all-in is yours.

edits.before: Warwick out-scales you: his passive heals harder as you drop and his W chase ignores your armor stacking entirely.
edits.after: Warwick out-scales you: Eternal Hunger triples its healing under 25% and Jaws is percent max health, so armour lies.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo is online — W a committed Warwick, knock him into terrain, then Q3 knock-up to win the trade before his Q drain heals it back.
edits.after: Your Q-W is online — W a committed Warwick into terrain for the stun, then the 2-stack Ntofo pull, and win the trade before Jaws heals it back.

edits.before: Warwick's R suppress is the threat window — his full-channel lockdown holds you in place, so save W's unstoppable to break the suppress and survive the all-in.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is the threat window — 1.5s of suppression on 110s at rank 1, and nothing in your kit shortens it, so hold E's shield and dash for the moment it ends.

edits.before: From 2+ items Warwick's passive heals harder the lower your HP and he chases anyone with W — your armor stacking does nothing to slow a fed drain bruiser, so you must close earlier.
edits.after: From 2+ items Eternal Hunger heals triple under 25% HP and Jaws of the Beast bites for percent max health — armour is the wrong answer to a fed drain bruiser, so close earlier.

edits.before: Warwick is a non-threat at Level 1 — his early is just Q drain last-hits and he has no real engage, so trade tip-of-Q poke and set up your lane. The matchup flips your way at Level 3 when your full Q-W combo comes online: W him into the wall for the longer stun, then Q3 to knock him up and pull him in. The key is timing — burst the trade fast, because if you let it drag his Q heal and passive lifesteal claw the HP back.
edits.after: Warwick is a non-threat at Level 1 — his early is Jaws of the Beast last-hits and he has no engage, so poke at the tip of Q and set up your lane. It flips your way at Level 3 when Q-W comes online: W him into the wall for the longer stun, then pull him back in with the 2-stack Ntofo. The key is timing — burst the trade fast, because if it drags, Jaws' heal and Eternal Hunger claw the HP straight back.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak as a tank — you out-trade a pre-item Warwick because his W only gives him move speed, no burst, so he can't punish your bulk. Trade around his Q drain cooldown and bank small leads. At 6 it evens out: his R is a full-channel suppress that holds you in place for the rest of his combo, so do NOT all-in with W down. Save W's unstoppable charge specifically to break the suppress and walk out of his commit.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak as a tank — you out-trade a pre-item Warwick because Blood Hunt gives only move and attack speed, no burst. Trade around Jaws of the Beast's 8s cooldown with Grievous Wounds up, and bank small leads. At 6 it evens: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5 seconds and nothing you own shortens it, so bait it near your tower, then punish the 110-second cooldown.

edits.before: Hold W's unstoppable charge to break his R suppress and win the post-6 all-in
edits.after: Bait Infinite Duress, then punish the 110s cooldown with your full Q-W pattern

edits.before: Land R suppress on you when your W charge is on cooldown so you can't escape the lock
edits.after: Land Infinite Duress while your dashes are down, or Primal Howl to fear you out of your combo

notes: Removed a fabricated mechanic repeated four times: 'W's unstoppable charge breaks his R suppress'. K'Sante's W is documented only as damage reduction, and Infinite Duress is a 1.5s suppression with no cleanse route in the kit data. Advice reframed around baiting the 110s cooldown. Primal Howl (E) was entirely absent and is now named.
